Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound on a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle struck the fornt of a
northbound sedan operated by Driver 2. The impact was low speed, but the front bumper, hood and both headlight
assemblies show damage that is generally cosnistent with a head-on contact of this kind. Driver 1 reported neck and
back strain at the scene and was transported for evaluation. A passenger in the vehicle was also present, though the
responding officer could not fully determine the seating position of the reporting driver at the moment of impact, as
accounts diffreed slightly on that point. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it, and two
independent witnesses gave consistent accounts. Scene photographs were taken and reviewed. No prior damage to
either vehicle was noted by the responding officer. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle involved.
</page>
